claim.claim-text: an accommodation space (AS) is defined between the protective cap (CA, CA1) and the guide (GP), the flexible printed circuit board (FPC) is accommodated in the accommodation space (AS), and one end of the accommodation space (AS) is an open end (OP) and another end of the accommodation space (AS) is a closed end (CP).
2. The display device as claimed in claim 1, wherein:
the flexible printed circuit board (FPC) includes a bending area (BA) that is bent, and the bending area (BA) is accommodated in the accommodation space (AS).
3. The display device as claimed in claim 1 or 2, further comprising a protective film on an outside of the flexible printed circuit board (FPC).
4. The display device as claimed in at least one claims 1 to 3, further comprising a driving chip (IC) on the flexible printed circuit board (FPC) or on the first display substrate (PA1).
5. The display device as claimed in claim 4, wherein an end of the protective cap (CA, CA1) covers the driving chip (IC).
6. The display device as claimed in at least one of claims 2 to 5, wherein a central portion (C) of the bending area (BA) is spaced apart from the protective cap (CA, CA1) and the guide (GP).
7. The display device as claimed in at least one of claims 1 to 6, wherein:
the guide (GP) includes a protruding curved surface, and the protective cap (CA, CA1) includes a recessed curved surface corresponding to the protruding curved surface.
8. The display device as claimed in at least one of claims 1 to 7, wherein a cross-section of the accommodation space (AS) has a laterally lying "U" shape.
9. The display device as claimed in at least one of claims 1 to 8, further comprising a cover (CO) that covers the open end (OP) of the accommodation space (AS).
10. The display device as claimed in at least one of claims 1 to 9, wherein a thickness (h1) of the guide (GP) is greater than a thickness (h2) of the body (BP).
